title: fissile limits output
description: `fissile limits --format json` (FS-010-limits.4): the tree's configured rule inventory, read from the config alone. An object rather than a bare array, so the inventory can gain a sibling section without breaking a consumer.

rules.description: Every rule of the effective rule set, in the order the config declares them, unfiltered by what any file matched (FS-010-limits.2). Empty when the config declares no rules.

id.description: The rule id, as the config spells it (FS-001-config.3).

include.description: The rule's include patterns, in declaration order (FS-010-limits.3).

exclude.description: The rule-local exclusion patterns, in declaration order; omitted when empty (FS-010-limits.4).

unit.description: The unit this rule measures in.

soft.description: The soft limit, which warns; omitted when the rule declares none (FS-010-limits.4).

soft_edit_limit.description: The effective continuous staged over-soft edit allowance, including the default 5. Present exactly when `soft` is present (FS-010-limits.4).

hard.description: The hard limit, which fails the commit; omitted when the rule declares none (FS-010-limits.4).

priority.description: What settles an overlap between two rules, `0` when the config omits it (FS-001-config.3.2). Always present, so two lines are comparable.

soft_message.description: The message id rendered on a soft overflow. Present only where the rule declares a soft limit: an undeclared severity borrows the other's template internally and that id is never rendered (FS-010-limits.4).

hard_message.description: The message id rendered on a hard overflow, present only where the rule declares a hard limit (FS-010-limits.4).

count_blank_lines.description: Whether blank lines count toward the budget (FS-001-config.3.1). Present only when `unit` is `lines`.

count_comment_lines.description: Whether whole-line comments count toward the budget (FS-001-config.3.1). Present only when `unit` is `lines`.
